nickname.description: The default nickname to use if IRNICK is not set in the environment.

realname.description: The real name (GECOS) associated with the nickname.

auto_join_channels.description: A list of channel names to automatically join after connecting to a server. Items must start with '#' or '&'.

servers.description: A list of server entries in host[:port][:password] format.

ssl_check.description: Default SSL verification level for IRC connections. Values: check, nocheck, off.

command_char.description: The character that prefixes ircII commands.

full_screen.description: If false, indicates a preference for dumb terminal mode (non-full-screen).
